q: In 2D maps, the twist condition for a Birkhoff annulus map (r, θ) ↦ (r + f(r,θ), θ + g(r,θ)) requires ∂g/∂r ≠ 0. This condition ensures the Poincaré-Birkhoff theorem applies, giving:
opts: At least two fixed points of the map for every rational rotation number
exp: Poincaré-Birkhoff theorem: an area-preserving twist map of an annulus has at least two fixed points (for any period-p/q approximation). The twist condition (rotation number varies monotonically with r) is essential. This is a cornerstone of KAM theory for 2D maps.
